title: Seagrove Orange Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Welcome to Seagrove Orange — a bright, comfortable, and spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo in a friendly gated community with private beach access and a sparkling pool. Perfectly suited for families or groups of up to 8!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Gated community with PRIVATE beach access - Communal grill area - Fully stocked kitchen - Modica welcome basket for 6+night stays (compliments of the owner) - Golf cart friendly neighborhood - Community pool - 4 minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Ready to feel right at home on 30A? Welcome to Seagrove Orange — a bright, comfortable, and spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo in a friendly gated community with private beach access and a sparkling pool. Perfectly suited for families or groups of up to 8, this end-unit retreat combines casual charm with plenty of space to gather and unwind. Guests love it so much, they return year after year! Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, right on scenic 30A, Seagrove Orange is situated on the second floor and easily accessible by elevator or stairs. Convenient parking at the rear of the building makes unloading and reloading hassle-free. Inside, a welcoming layout provides both privacy and plenty of communal space. All three bedrooms are set along a central hallway: - Queen bedroom with en-suite bath (tub/shower combo) - Bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks and an adjacent full bath (accessible from the bedroom or hall) - King master suite, featuring a spacious dressing and vanity area, walk-in closet, and a large en-suite with jetted tub, walk-in shower, and dual sink spaces - A laundry room is also tucked along the hallway for your convenience. At the end of the hall, the space opens up to a light-filled open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area. The fully equipped kitchen includes an eat-in bar, and the large dining table is perfect for meals or game nights. The living area invites you to relax with plenty of comfortable seating, a 55” HD Smart TV, and even a cozy fireplace for cooler months. Step out onto the private balcony to enjoy views of 30A and the sparkling community pool below. There’s plenty of seating and a dining table for enjoying snacks, drinks, or a meal al fresco. During your stay, you’ll love spending time at the large community pool — heated in March and April — or strolling or biking to your private beach access just down the road. Community pictures included are of Rosemary Beach, Seaside and Watercolor- all located within a few miles and an easy bike ride! Whether you’re here for sunny days on the sand, poolside lounging, or simply making memories together, Seagrove Orange offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and 30A charm. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Parking for 2 cars on first come, first served basis. * Close and easy beach access steps from your unit! FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
